subject: ACME: carryover commit + contingency play
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ACME: carryover commit + contingency play

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time last week. Finance flagged this opportunity as a carryover risk for Q4 unless we can firm up PO timing and final pricing this month. Can you please update the committed stage in your procurement system and share any blocking items currently preventing signature?

Quick asks to move this forward:
- Confirm target signature date (EOW Nov 26 ideal)
- Confirm any vendor-side docs procurement needs (SOW, evidence, insurance)
- Let us know if a limited-time discount is required to lock in 

I've attached a first-pass save plan (ACME_SavePlan_v1.xlsx) with proposed contingency plays (payment milestones, ramp credits). Marking Markus & Stephanie for internal align on discount thresholds and approval path.

If easier, happy to put a 30-min call on calendar with procurement this week.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com

Attachments: ACME_SavePlan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stubs)

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME: carryover commit + contingency play

Jordan —

Appreciate the note and the save plan. Procurement is reviewing but wanted to flag two open items from our side: 1) our security team requested a short SOC 2 addendum; 2) legal needs the final SOW to align on indemnity language. I copied procurement@acme.com — they'll own confirming the exact docs.

Target internal timeline: procurement hopes to complete vendor review by Nov 24 but will need a final pricing doc and confirmation on concession limits.

We can do a 30-min sync on Nov 20 if that helps. I can also route a PO to you once legal signs off.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Senior Buyer, ACME Corp
olivia@acme.com

Attachment: (none)

Subject: RE: ACME: carryover commit + contingency play

Jordan / Steph —

I reviewed the save plan and pushed updates into ACME_SavePlan_v2.xlsx (attached). Short summary of internal POV:
- Risk rating: YELLOW (probability still ~45% without concession)
- I added two options: (A) one-time 10% first-year concession tied to 60% upfront payment; (B) extended onboarding credit instead of price reduction if procurement pushes on TCO language.
- Finance needs an exec request for any concession >8% (we should route through Laura).

Next steps I propose:
1) Jordan, run the Nov 20 sync with Olivia & procurement to confirm documents needed.
2) If procurement asks for pricing flexibility, escalate to Laura with the attached save plan and ask for one-time approval.

I'll be available on the call to cover margin impact.

-markus

Head of Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: ACME: carryover commit + contingency play — call invite + pricing note

Olivia / procurement team —

Thanks. I set a 30-min sync for Nov 22 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Agenda: 1) confirm outstanding docs (SOW, SOC 2 addendum), 2) pricing ask / concession thresholds, 3) signature timeline.

For transparency, finance asked we keep any concession <=8% off-list to avoid exec escalation. If procurement requires more (~10%), we'll need a one-time approval from Laura. I've attached a short pricing summary (pricing_summary.pdf) that outlines list vs proposed concession scenarios so procurement can react quickly on the call.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_summary.pdf

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME: carryover commit + contingency play — call confirm

Jordan —

Thanks for scheduling. Procurement confirms they'll have a draft SOW and the list of required security artifacts by end of day Nov 23. On pricing: they asked whether Redwood can consider a 10% introductory discount in exchange for a 12-month committed volume and milestone-based payment.

If you can get approval for a one-time 10% concession we can commit to signature by Nov 26 and route PO that day. Otherwise, procurement will need to escalate and the timeline slips beyond Q4.

Talking point for the call: can you bring a concise concession play and the margin impact?

—Olivia

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: URGENT: Exec approval request — ACME one-time concession (10%) for Q4 save

Laura —

Quick note: ACME procurement has proposed a conditional path to signature that requires a one-time introductory concession of 10% (tied to a 12-month committed volume + 60% upfront). If we approve, procurement commits to routing PO by Nov 26 (keeps deal in Q4). If we decline, ACME will escalate and push signing into Jan.

Attached: ACME_SavePlan_v2.xlsx, pricing_summary.pdf (short margin bullets below).

Impact summary (high level):
- ARR at stake: $1.2M ARR first-year equivalent
- Margin impact if concession granted: ~6% incremental margin erosion in year-1 (net of upfront)
- Strategic: ACME is a reference customer in our retail vertical; keeping them in Q4 preserves momentum for our regional targets.

Request: one-time approval to offer up to 10% introductory concession tied to milestones (decision required by EOD Nov 23 to make Nov 26 signature).

Thanks for the quick review — happy to jump on a brief call if you want to walk through.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com
